title: Staff Data Architect
description:
**Job Details:**

The Staff Enterprise Data Architect develops standards, tools, and governance for capturing, modeling, storing, and delivering data for the enterprise, including:


Identifying data\-related business requirements and service standards (e.g., transaction processing speed, data mining and reporting capabilities, data security, scalability, etc.).


Developing a high\-level enterprise data model and conceptual views of related data sub\-architectures (e.g., database, data integration, data warehouse/business intelligence, reporting, metadata, and content management architectures).


Optimizing overall data/information flow by reducing redundancy and enabling accessibility within security boundaries. Staff Architects in Enterprise Data Architecture oversee one or more Data Engineering Disciplines.

  

  

* Interpret enterprise data architecture, governance standards, and platform direction (BigQuery, Palantir Foundry, Workday/SAP ecosystem) and translate them into a concrete data strategy and roadmap for HR \& Payroll.
* Design and guide data models, pipelines, and integration patterns connecting HCM/Payroll systems to the enterprise data lake/warehouse.
* Stay hands\-on with SQL, data modeling, and pipeline/ETL work\- able to dig into complex data problems alongside the team, not just review their output.
* Serve as the domain's data quality and governance owner: data lineage, validation, metadata/cataloging (e.g., Collibra), and compliance with data privacy requirements for HR data.
* Manage, coach, and grow a data team based in India: day\-to\-day leadership, performance management, career development, and acting as the trusted on\-the\-ground manager for a remote\-from\-HQ team.
* Partner with HR/Payroll business stakeholders to turn ambiguous business questions into data requirements and analytics\-ready solutions.
* Act as a bridge between enterprise architecture/IT leadership and the HR/Payroll domain\- representing domain needs upward, and enterprise standards downward.
  

  

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  

  

Technical Standards and Governance:


Establishing and maintaining enterprise\-wide technical standards, guidelines, and best practices for software development, quality, and infrastructure.


Ensuring compliance with these standards across all programs and projects.


Perform other assigned job\-related duties that align with our organization's vision, mission, and values and fall within your scope of practice.


Architecture Design and Review:


Designing scalable, reliable, and secure architecture solutions that align with business goals and technical requirements.


Conducting architecture reviews and providing guidance to ensure alignment with enterprise standards.


Cross\-Disciplinary Expertise:


Leveraging expertise in software development, quality engineering, and infrastructure engineering to provide holistic architectural solutions.


Ensuring seamless integration of development, quality, and infrastructure components.


Technology Evaluation and Selection:


Evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies, tools, and platforms aligned with enterprise standards and business needs.


Conducting proof\-of\-concept (PoC) projects to validate technology choices. Collaboration and Communication:


Collaborating with development, quality, and infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.


Facilitating communication and knowledge sharing across teams and departments.


Continuous Improvement:


Promoting a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance technical standards and practices.


Staying up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure the enterprise remains competitive.


Security and Compliance:


Ensuring that security best practices are integrated into all aspects of the enterprise architecture.


Maintaining compliance with industry standards, regulations, and internal policies.


Performance and Scalability:


Designing solutions that ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability.


Conducting performance assessments and optimizations to meet enterprise requirements.


Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity:


Ensuring that all architectural solutions include robust backup and recovery mechanisms.


Quality Assurance and Testing:


Ensuring that automated testing, continuous integration, and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices are consistently applied.


Documentation and Knowledge Management:


Creating and maintaining comprehensive architectural documentation, including diagrams, standards, and guidelines.


Ensuring that documentation is accessible and up to date for all stakeholders. Vendor and Tool Management:


Manage relationships with technology vendors and ensure that tools and services meet enterprise standards.


Evaluating and integrating third\-party solutions as needed.


Incident Management and Troubleshooting:


Providing high\-level support for incident management and troubleshooting complex technical issues.


Conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures. Capacity Planning and Resource Management:


Conducting capacity planning ensures enterprise architecture can handle current and future workloads.


Managing resources effectively to support enterprise\-wide initiatives.


Training and Mentorship:


Providing training and mentorship to technical teams to ensure adherence to enterprise standards.


Supporting professional development and knowledge sharing within the organization.

  

  

Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's Degree or relevant experience. Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Quantitative or Engineering Field preferred.


Preferred Certification(s): TOGAF, Cloud (AWS or GCP), Security, SAP, SAFe. Experience: 7\+ years of relevant and practical experience. Special Skills Required:


Deep technical expertise in one or more areas of focus, e.g., Data Engineering, Data Modeling, Data Platforms.


The ability to explain highly technical conc

  

  

epts to non\-technical team members and leaders.


Self\-driven ability to vet new technical patterns, influence decision\-makers, and establish those patterns as new technical standards.

No

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**About the role:**



We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on HR professional with 5\+ years of HR experience to manage end\-to\-end people operations while working closely with leadership in the USA. This role is execution\-focused with strategic exposure, requiring strong ownership of core HR processes (including Talent Acquisition) and people leadership.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable operating independently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

  


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


**Strategic HR**


* Drive HR initiatives and processes in alignment with organizational objectives and business priorities

  


**Talent Acquisition**


* Actively participate in and improve Talent Acquisition processes to support WIN's rapid growth

  


**Employee Lifecycle Management**


* Handle complete onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth and compliant employee experience
* Nurture relationships with employees with empathy, kindness, and fairness

  


**Payroll, Compensation \& Benefits**


* Independently handle payroll processing, benefits, and compliance
* Coordinate with finance and external vendors

  


**HR Operations \& HRIS Management**


* Maintain and update HRMS and ATS, ensuring accurate records and up\-to\-date reports
* Drive process improvements in HR operations and workflows

  


**Statutory \& Compliance (India)**


* Manage statutory compliances, filings, and HR audits
* Ensure adherence to labor laws and internal HR policies

  


**Employer Branding**


* Support and execute employer branding initiatives on social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn, to promote hiring, culture, and workplace updates

  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**


* 5\+ years of full\-time HR experience in HRBP / Talent Acquisition
* Solid understanding of compensation, benefits, and statutory compliance as per Indian labour laws
* Experience working closely with senior stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  


**NICE TO HAVE:**


* Prior experience working with international stakeholders (US preferred)

  


**WHAT WE OFFER:**


* Highly inclusive and collaborative culture
* Opportunity to work closely with India\-based and US\-based teams
* Strong focus on learning, ownership, and growth
* 100% remote working flexibility

  


**ABOUT WIN \& OUR CULTURE:**



WIN is the \#1 ranked inspection services company in the United States. Backed by 35 years of excellence, we are on a mission to build a global brand through cutting\-edge technologies, AI\-driven innovation, and operational excellence. WIN has the stability of an established leader as well as the energy of a fast\-growing organization. We offer like\-minded professionals a unique opportunity for meaningful personal and professional growth.

title: Senior Human Resource Associate, Shared Service Centre
description:
**About Us**



Our leading SaaS\-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G\-P, we're dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.



Our diverse, remote\-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.



The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.



At G\-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

**About The Position:**



As a Sr Human Resource Associate, within our Regional Shared Service Centre you will join a fast\-growing company and will have responsibility for supporting professionals we engage on behalf of our client. You will assist in the management of the back\-end HR, Payroll, and legal service providers that support the infrastructure of our international entities. We are looking for someone with global exposure and experience throughout EMEA/APAC/AMER  

  

**Please note: this is a 9 month fixed term contract and we are ideally looking for someone who can start immediately**  

  

**What You Will Do:**


* Support key employee life cycle processes such as onboarding of new professionals, professionals' data management, absence managements, visa renewals. transfers, offboarding of professionals.
* Preparing HR documentation, i.e. employment contracts, employment contract amendments, HR policies, benefits enrollment documentation, payroll enrollment documentation, country\-specific onboarding guides,employment certificates, certification of termination
* Organize and maintain employee records via our proprietary Platform: input, update and maintain customer \& professional personal data, process various forms related to documenting human resources activities such as new hire, change of status, benefits, terminations, etc.
* Benefits administration on behalf of customers \& professionals including collaboration with broker/insurer for professionals' benefits enrollments.
* Provide payroll data, including time and expense details, to support payroll administration, working in close coordination with the payroll team and Local Payroll Provider.
* Carry out audits and checks on data changes to ensure accurate and timely payment for the professionals
* Participation in the continuous improvement of HR processes and assist in maintaining standard operating procedures and policies up to date
* Communicate effectively both verbally and in written form with professionals and our customers to explain and resolve queries and concerns (via email, and other means of communication)
* Ensure service excellence by following and committing to the established SLAs and SOPs
* Communicate and liaise with GP partners/vendors, including insurance vendors, local service providers, local payroll providers, pension providers ensuring strong collaboration and seamless coordination including internal teams in GP.
* First point of contact for professionals\& customers during the onboarding and offboarding process

  


**What We Are Looking For:**

**Minimum Requirements:**


* 2\-5 years of HR operations experience (SSC experience desirable)
* Detailed knowledge of HR Procedures and policies
* Experience working within a Shared Services
* Basic knowledge of labor legislation throughout the EMEA region will be an added advantage
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Proficient in both written and verbal English with the ability to articulate clearly and effectively in various communication settings.
* Literacy with MS Office
* Possess a proactive 'test\-and\-learn' mindset; capable of quickly mastering and deploying new AI features and platforms due to fast pace environment.
* Demonstrated AI literacy with the ability to integrate generative AI tools (e.g.,Gemini, Notebook LM) into daily workflows to increase efficiency and output quality.
* Resourceful, problem\-solving abilities with a focus on identifying and/or resolving issues effectively.
* Experience in stakeholder management, including building positive relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrating strong self\-motivation, attention to detail, and time management skills
* Ability to work in an international team composed of team members in different locations and from different cultures and backgrounds.
* Flexibility to accommodate different time zones based on customer and professional needs.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Knowledge and experience in handling offboardings will be an added advantage.


Our ranges are established using objective market benchmarking data for this level of work. Final placement within the range is determined by gender\-neutral criteria, including the candidate's relevant skills, experience, and specific qualifications for the role.



Actual compensation for this position may vary and will depend on multiple factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location. For Full\-Time Regular Employees, this position is also eligible for additional compensation as follows:

  

* Sales Roles: This position is eligible for a commission structure in addition to base salary.
* Non\-Sales Roles: This position is eligible for an annual bonus which is paid dependent on various factors, including and without limitation, individual and company performance in addition to base salary.


**Benefits**



G\-P values its employees and offers excellent benefits and perks including generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, spending accounts, medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, sabbatical after 5 years and more.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

At Smiths we apply leading\-edge technology to design, manufacture and deliver smarter engineering solutions for mission\-critical applications, solving some of the world's toughest problems for our customers, our communities and our world. We are a FTSE100, global business of around 15,000 colleagues, based in 50 countries.


Our solutions have a real impact on lives across the planet, enabling industry, improving healthcare, enhancing security, advancing connectivity, and supporting new homes. Our products and services are often critical to our customers’ operations, while our proprietary technology and high service levels help create competitive advantage. We welcome colleagues with a curious mind, who are happy with responsibility, enjoy a challenge and are attracted by the idea of working at a business with an almost 170\-year history of innovation, and four global divisions, all experts in their field.

 **Job Description** **Job Purpose:** As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the technology services that support Smiths' global operations. Working across infrastructure, networking and cloud technologies, you will help deliver reliable, secure and modern services for colleagues worldwide while contributing to technology improvement and transformation initiatives.


We are looking for a proactive individual who takes ownership, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and is motivated to identify opportunities to improve the user experience, resolve problems and help colleagues succeed.

**Responsibilities:**

* Proactively ensure high levels of systems and infrastructure availability
* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end solutions spanning multiple operating systems, cloud platforms and networking technologies
* Support and administer Microsoft operating systems, Hyper\-V, Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure and Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI)
* Install, configure, test and maintain operating systems, application software, backup solutions and system management tools
* Support the management and optimisation of LAN and wireless infrastructure (Cisco / Meraki)
* Diagnose and resolve LAN and wireless networking issues
* Identify opportunities to improve network and wireless performance
* Assist with operational ticket management, incident resolution and service improvements
* Support the implementation and adoption of Smiths BIS standards
* Collaborate with colleagues across infrastructure, cloud, networking and service teams to deliver effective technology solutions

**Planning and Decision Making:**

* Identify opportunities to enhance infrastructure services, processes and user experience
* Anticipate potential issues and take preventative action where possible
* Prioritise activities and issues effectively within a complex global environment
* Contribute ideas and recommendations that support continuous improvement and operational excellence
* Work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners to resolve problems and shape future technology direction

**Impact and Scope:**

* Global scope supporting all Smiths divisions and business functions
* Contribute to the delivery of secure, reliable and high\-performing technology services used by colleagues worldwide
* Support infrastructure services that enable business operations, productivity and growth across the organisation

**Key Internal and External Relationships:**

* Demonstrate and promote Smiths Core Values: Customer Focus, Ownership, Integrity, Safety and Respect
* Build strong working relationships with Infrastructure Management, Service Management, Business Partnering and Infrastructure teams
* Collaborate with colleagues across technology functions to deliver reliable and effective services
* Maintain productive relationships with strategic vendors including AT\&T and other third\-party technology partners

  

**Qualifications** **Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Experience supporting Wintel infrastructure, including Windows Server administration, patching and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and identity management
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, identity lifecycle management and hybrid identity solutions
* Experience or exposure to Azure Local (HCI) environments and their integration with on\-premises and cloud infrastructure
* Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and performance issues within a remote support environment
* Understanding of networking fundamentals; CCNA certification or equivalent practical experience is advantageous
* Knowledge of Cisco LAN, Cisco Wireless, Cisco Prime and Cisco ISE products and services would be beneficial
* Experience with tools such as SolarWinds, BMC Helix, BeyondTrust PRA or Guardicore is desirable
* Ability to collaborate effectively across networking, server, cloud and identity teams
* Knowledge of ITIL methodology; ITIL certification is advantageous
* A willingness to learn new technologies and continually develop technical expertise
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality outcomes
* Proactive approach to identifying, investigating and resolving issues
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a customer\-focused mindset

  

**Additional Information**  

We recognise that no candidate is likely to meet every requirement listed. If your experience and skills aligns with the behaviours we’re looking for and many of the skills and responsibilities outlined, we would encourage you to apply.


At Smiths, we value diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work.

  

With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross\-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity.


Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network.


Join us for a great career with competitive compensation and benefits, while helping engineer a better future.

**Planning and Decision Making:**

* Erroneous decisions or recommendations are not likely to result in failure to achieve major goals and objectives of the organization

**Impact and Scope:**

* Geographic scope of the support provided by this role is global.
* Interacts regularly with employees, line managers, Talent Acquisition and HR across the business.

**Key Internal and External Relationships:**

* Employees and Line Managers across Smiths divisions and functions.
* TA, HR colleagues supporting the COEs and Smiths divisions

  

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.


At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Group, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website (Careers \- Smiths Group plc)

OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture.
